title: Fixed Offset Two Layer Pyramid Grid Roof
description: One complete newly authored static double-layer space-grid roof frame. A flat upper square chord network and a smaller parallel lower chord network are offset by half a cell in each plan direction. Every lower joint connects through four complete diagonals to the corners of the upper square above it, giving nine genuinely open downward-pyramid cells and a visible finite roof-frame depth. Solid joint hubs carry whole member ends; four full-height cylindrical columns meet lower corner nodes and stand on four finite square footings. Unlike the old single-layer hemispherical geodesic-style network and the shallow planar hangar truss, this is a flat two-plane offset spatial graph with internal pyramidal webs, not a change of rod count or colour in either old model. All rods, nodes and supports newly authored; no mesh imported or extracted. Four opaque PBR roles, metre-style Z up, horizontal bounds-centred ground origin, one architectural module zero scenes. Open frame only: no roof cladding, wall, glazing, equipment, weather protection or certified connection detail. No structural analysis, load, stiffness, span, stability, manufacture, installation, host interchangeability, building-code or safety capability claimed. No rigging, animation or interaction.
